records.text: :tada: New signup: *Union Media* just joined on the pro plan!

decisions.rationale: Signup 6 days ago, first_project reached day 0 and 1 invite sent, so there's real early momentum. But no key_milestone, zero replies to two outreach emails (email:f9eafb06, email:c404ec26) and no tickets suggests engagement tapered; 8 days left makes unaided activation possible but not likely.

draft.subject: One next step for Union Media
draft.body:
Hi Ahmed,

You've got a project created and an invite out already -- nice start. In Wrenfield, projects are the main organizing unit, and tasks live inside them, so the next bit of value usually comes from putting real work into that first project alongside a teammate.

If it's useful, I can hop on a short call this week and help you map your current workflow into that project -- or just reply here and I'll point you in the right direction.

Best,
Priya
